Class MicronautMcpHttpExchange

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.mcp.client.http.MicronautMcpHttpExchange
@Internal public final class MicronautMcpHttpExchange extends Object
Sends the JSON-RPC messages of an MCP client to a server over Streamable HTTP with the Micronaut HTTP client, and reads the messages of the response, a JSON body or an event stream, as they arrive. The messages are decoded on the event loop, then published on a scheduler that may block, which parses them and calls the client.

    • post

      public reactor.core.publisher.Flux<String> post(String message, Map<String,String> headers, boolean initialize)
      Sends a JSON-RPC message.
      Parameters:
      message - The message, as JSON
      headers - The headers of the request, such as those computed when the client was called
      initialize - Whether the message initializes a session, which is then sent without the previous session id
      Returns:
      The messages of the response, as JSON: none for an accepted notification, one for a JSON response, or each message of an event stream, as it arrives. A JSON-RPC error answered with an error status is a message too. Fails with McpHttpSessionNotFoundException when the server no longer knows the session.

    • post

      public reactor.core.publisher.Flux<String> post(String message, Map<String,String> headers, boolean initialize, @Nullable Predicate<String> response)
      Sends a JSON-RPC message, resuming the event stream of the response when the server closes it before it sends the response, as the server may: with a GET that carries the Last-Event-ID of the stream, after the retry delay of the stream, until the response arrives, the cursor is cleared, or the subscriber cancels.
      Parameters:
      message - The message, as JSON
      headers - The headers of the request
      initialize - Whether the message initializes a session
      response - Whether a message of the server is the response to this one, or null for a message that expects no response, whose stream is not resumed
      Returns:
      The messages of the response, see post(String, Map, boolean)

    • listen

      public reactor.core.publisher.Flux<String> listen()
      Opens the stream of the messages the server sends on its own, such as requests and notifications.
      Returns:
      The messages of the stream. Fails with McpHttpSessionNotFoundException when the server no longer knows the session, and with an HttpClientResponseException of status 405 when the server does not offer a stream.
